defaultBarks: Busy day on the streets. Watch your step.
Keep moving, traveler — plenty to do before sundown.
Quiet enough around here, if you don't look for trouble.
Mind the cobblestones; they're slick after rain.

merchant: Step inside if you're buying; window-shopping doesn't pay the guild dues.
Caravans came in light this week, so prices are holding firm.
Coin on the counter and I'll wrap whatever you need.
tavern keeper: Hearth's lit and the kegs are tapped — pull up a stool inside.
Keep steel sheathed in my taproom and we'll get along fine.
Rooms go fast when the road-mud gets knee-deep.
bank teller: Letters of credit and deeds are handled strictly inside the counting house.
Every copper is tallied to the ledger before sundown.
The bank keeps its doors open for honest accounts.
guard: Keep your blade sheathed and move along, citizen.
The watch sees more than folks give us credit for.
Stay out of the alleys after dark if you value your purse.
priest: May the Divines steady your road, traveler.
The sanctuary doors are open to the faithful and the wounded alike.
Walk gently; grace is quieter than thunder.
witch: Not every omen belongs in broad daylight.
The hills remember older oaths than any court.
Mind what you promise beneath a thin moon.

noble: Mind your manners — the court has little patience for muddy boots.
Every banner in the Bay watches every other.
Speak to a steward if you have business with the house.
mage: Careful — a half-bound ward does not care who trips over it.
The Guild's lamps burn late when the sky turns strange.
If you're bringing curious relics, keep them wrapped.
warrior: Good steel beats loud bragging every time.
Keep your edge oiled; the roads outside the walls aren't tame.
Looking for a contract? Check the Guild hall.
assassin: You didn't see me, and I didn't see you.
Best not to linger where shadows cross.
child: Bet I can run to the market gate faster than you!
Did you see the riders come through the gate?
Mother says not to wander near the old walls after dusk.

Redguard guides know every dune ridge between here and Sentinel.
16: Stone walls hold against the Wrothgarian gales, barely.

17: Fog off the Bay clings to Daggerfall's towers half the morning.

Between Castle Daggerfall and the harbor, there's never a dull hour.
19: Salt wind off Betony's cliffs cuts right through wool.

Tides turn quick along the strait — check the piers.
20: Keep to the shaded arcades in Sentinel once the noon sun climbs.
Ships from across the Iliac crowd Sentinel's docks from dawn till dusk.
Queen Akorithi's banners fly high over the palace quarter today.
22: Lainlyn's traders watch both the desert road and the Bay.
Dust on the wind means another Hammerfell caravan's nearing the gate.

26: Out near Orsinium, folks judge you by your nerve, not your lineage.
Keep your wits sharp on the mountain roads.

Desert: Drink before you're thirsty; the desert sun gives no second warning.
Sand finds its way into every buckle and boot by noon.
Travel at dawn or dusk if you want your mount to last.
Desert2: Dry wind off the dunes carries grit all the way to the market square.
Shade's worth more than silver when the glare hits the sandstone.
Caravans hug the wells along these desert tracks.
Subtropical: Warm sea air off the southern coast keeps the markets lively till late.
Spices and citrus dry along the rooftops all afternoon.
The breeze off the Bay cools the stone once the sun dips.
Mountain: Thin air and steep trails — keep your footing on the scree.
Hearths burn all day up here, even when the sky looks clear.
Wrap your shoulders; mountain weather turns in a heartbeat.
MountainWoods: Pine smoke and damp timber — you can smell the high woods from the square.
Loggers and hunters trade down here before the passes freeze.
Keep to the marked track through the evergreens.
Swamp: Mire-fog settles before sunset; don't lose sight of the lanterns.
Dry boots are a rare luxury anywhere near the fens.
Keep off the soft turf outside the causeway.
Rainforest: Green canopy holds the mist long after the rain stops.
Everything stays damp here — oil your blade twice as often.
The jungle road grows back fast if caravans skip a week.
Woodlands: Clear sky over the woods today — good weather for the road.
Carts roll through the market from every village in the shire.
Mind the ruts outside the gate after a heavy shower.
HauntedWoodlands: Folks bar their shutters early when mist creeps out of the barrows.
Don't follow stray lights off the road after sundown.
The old trees around here keep an uneasy quiet.

Mind your scrolls — the Mages Guild remembers who keeps its confidence.
41: The Fighters Guild takes clean contracts and sharper blades.

42: Keep your voice down — the Guild doesn't advertise on the notice board.

108: The Night Mother hears more than the city watch ever will.

450: The Temples stand open to all who seek grace and healing.

May the Divines keep our shrines and roads in peace.

201: Castle Daggerfall's banners still rule these walls.

204: Sentinel's fleets and banners watch the whole southern Bay.

207: Wayrest's court weighs coin and loyalty on the same scale.

358: Orsinium's iron holds the mountain passes against all comers.
